providers.name: aws
providers.notes: Public Price List Bulk API; no auth. Gate file owns the endpoint and regional fan-out logic.

providers.name: gcp
providers.notes: Cloud Billing Catalog API; public data but API key required for quota tracking. Set GCP_API_KEY in .env; see .env.example. Gate file owns the Compute Engine service id (6F81-5844-456A) and pagination (max pageSize 5000).

providers.name: azure
providers.notes: Retail Prices API; no auth. Gate file owns the OData filter for VMs and pagination.

providers.name: oracle
providers.notes: Public price list API at apexapps.oracle.com/pls/apex/cetools; no auth, no pagination, single-shot ~3 MB. List price is global per SKU (no per-region split in the data). Compute SKUs live alongside everything else under serviceCategory; modern shapes (E3-E5, X9, A1) price OCPU and memory separately.

providers.name: vultr
providers.notes: Public /v2/plans endpoint; no auth, no pagination, single-shot ~70 KB / 100 plans. Each plan carries monthly_cost, hourly_cost, vcpu_count, ram, disk, bandwidth, type, and locations[] for availability. Price is global per plan (locations[] is availability, not a pricing dimension).

providers.name: linode
providers.notes: Public /v4/linode/types endpoint; no auth, single page, ~42 KB / 75 types. Distinctive schema: each type has a base price.{hourly,monthly} that applies globally PLUS an explicit region_prices[] list of per-region overrides. Currently only br-gru and id-cgk publish overrides; everything else falls back to base. Agent must read region_prices[] before quoting a region-specific number.

providers.name: ibm
providers.notes: Public Global Catalog API at globalcatalog.cloud.ibm.com/api/v1; no auth. Gate walks three hops: (1) catalog query paginated 50/page (~7 pages, ~319 services, ~6 MB), (2) for compute service names (is.instance, is.bare-metal-server, is.dedicated-host) follow children_url to enumerate plans (~237 plans total in v0), (3) call /{plan_id}/pricing/deployment per plan to get per-region prices. The deployment endpoint returns every region the plan exists in inline. Real compute numbers live only at this third hop: plain /pricing returns $0 for base instance-hours because base price is fully regional. Snapshot stores each response as sent: catalog-NNNN.json, children-<service>-NNNN.json, and one pricing-<plan_id>.json per plan (~1.4 MB each, every region, metric, and country/currency combination inline).

providers.name: scaleway
providers.notes: Public Product Catalog API (api.scaleway.com/product-catalog/v2alpha1/public-catalog/products), no auth, paged 100 per page with total_count. EUR only; stored unconverted in hourly_eur (ADR 0019).

providers.name: ovh
providers.notes: Public order catalog per subsidiary, no auth: api.us.ovhcloud.com (USD, US regions) and api.ovh.com with ovhSubsidiary=FR (EUR excl. VAT, Europe and APAC). Prices are integers in 1e-8 of the currency.

providers.name: exoscale
providers.notes: portal.exoscale.com/api/pricing/opencompute (undocumented, no auth, chf/eur/usd) joined with the public v2 instance-type list (api-ch-gva-2.exoscale.com/v2/instance-type). One price for every zone.

providers.name: cherryservers
providers.notes: Public /v1/plans (api.cherryservers.com), no auth, unpaged, currency=USD. Bare metal, VPS and VDS; some bare metal also has spot hourly prices.

providers.name: runpod
providers.notes: GraphQL gpuTypes query POSTed to api.runpod.io/graphql without a key. Per GPU-hour prices for Secure and Community Cloud; spot prices need a key and come back null.
